title.zh: 狭义相对论 · 同时性的线倾斜了
title.en: Special Relativity · The Lines of “Now” Tilt

desc.zh: 光速对谁都一样，于是时间会变慢、长度会缩短、“同时”变得因人而异——时空图把这些画给你看。
desc.en: The speed of light is the same for everyone, so clocks run slow, lengths shrink and “at the same time” depends on who is looking — a spacetime diagram draws it all.
